---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for this project
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What problem does this solve? Who runs into it, and how often? (A
feature request grounded in a real workflow gap is much easier to
evaluate than "it would be nice if...".)

## Proposed solution

Describe what you'd like to see. If you have an opinion on the shape of
the API/UI, include it — it's easier to react to a concrete proposal
than to design one from scratch.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why you didn't propose them
instead.

## Scope check

- [ ] I've checked this isn't already covered by an existing permission,
      plan-limit, or configuration option.
- [ ] This is additive (a new capability), not a request to change
      existing behavior that other users may depend on — if it *is* a
      breaking change, please say so explicitly above.

## Additional context

Mockups, links to similar features in other products, or anything else
that helps explain the request.
